features.model1: log squared Frobenius norm of dW per module from sv.npy, standardised on the training rows, modules with a zero update in any training LoRA dropped, all divided by sqrt(number of modules)
features.model2: model1 columns + sqrt(block weight) x 14 columns: mean cosine of the o update of layers 17-23 with the imperial basis LoRAs and with the modern basis LoRAs (from K_grp and sv), standardised on the training rows, / sqrt(14)

fit: ridge on centred features; penalty (grid 1e-4 .. 1e4 x top singular value squared, half-decade steps) and, for model 2, the block weight (0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3) by exact leave-one-out on the training rows only; training rows = all non-basis imperial LoRAs of chunks 0-59; no holdout label was read

expected_from_cross_validation.note: Pearson r, imperial TRAIN, 1,520 scored LoRAs, gw.FOLD; check_o.py. Spearman for model 1: 0.44, 0.43, 0.56.
